answer: The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, clawed back after a replayed submission, rewards vest against future work. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the horizon of a task receipt, and the walnut is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Reaching the orchard of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
